no-restricted-syntax.message: [LCP] External stylesheets block rendering. The browser cannot paint anything until the CSS downloads. Use Tailwind classes or inline styles.
[LCP] document.write() destroys the browser preload scanner, adding seconds to page load. This is never acceptable.
[LCP] document.writeln() destroys the browser preload scanner. This is never acceptable.
[CLS] <video> element detected. Ensure width/height attributes or style={{ aspectRatio: '16/9' }} are set to prevent layout shift.
[CLS] <iframe> element detected. Ensure width/height attributes are set to prevent layout shift.
[CLS] dangerouslySetInnerHTML can inject content that causes layout shifts and bypasses performance checks. Use React components to render dynamic content.
[INP] import * pulls the entire package into the bundle. Use named imports: import { specificFunction } from 'package'. This allows tree-shaking.
[BUNDLE] fetch() is not allowed in widgets. Widgets receive data through the 'data' prop from the page builder. Add a dataSource to your template's dataSources config.
[BUNDLE] window.fetch() is not allowed in widgets. Widgets receive data through the 'data' prop from the page builder.
[BUNDLE] require() prevents code splitting. Use ES import syntax: import { fn } from 'package'.
[THIRD-PARTY] <script> tags are not allowed in widgets. External scripts bypass all performance optimization. Use an approved npm package.
[THIRD-PARTY] document.createElement('script') is not allowed. External scripts bypass performance optimization.
[LCP] window.location assignment causes full page reload. Use next/link or useRouter().push() for navigation.
[LCP] location.href assignment causes full page reload. Use next/link or useRouter().push() for navigation.
